task.name: pick_block_drawer_to_plate
task.description: Use the right arm to pick up the purple block from inside the drawer and place it on the plate. Then, use the left arm to push the drawer closed.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the purple block inside the drawer.
2. Grasp the purple block with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to align with the plate.
4. Release the gripper to place the purple block on the plate.
5. Move the left arm to approach and align with the drawer handle.
6. Push the drawer closed using the left arm.
